scope: Only active map structures and their existing state frames. New proposals only; no seasons. Character/enemy art and inventory-only items excluded.

recommendation.rationale: Retain the original green weathering, roof detail and boarded door. Lift lightness and nudge the official palette by only 10%; do not replace its original material colours.

rows.name: Produce stands: seven product counters
rows.assessment: Seven 80px frames share a good counter silhouette; numerous small wares compete with the awning at runtime.

recommendation.rationale: Keep all seven existing product mappings; simplify goods to large readable silhouettes, use bark/earth for timber and retain a small product-specific awning cue. These are existing functional frames, not seven new zone variants.

rows.name: Old-trade-road broken wagon
rows.assessment: Good memorable road landmark; 128px generated shading is much denser than one-cell props.

recommendation.rationale: Keep broken covered wagon because inspected MiniWorld boat/transport sprites are not semantic replacements. Reduce canvas to cream/stone_light and timber to bark/earth; retain missing wheel and damaged canopy.

rows.prevalenceReason: Surface bus-stop POI on old trade road only; does not apply to every bus stop.
rows.spawnEvidence: src/street_variants.js bus-stop banditStop tagging → src/loot.js chestLook
rows.consumers: Surface bus-stop POI on old trade road only; does not apply to every bus stop.

recommendation.rationale: Keep approved milestone form; reduce to stone_shadow/stone/stone_light with one lichen patch. A new variant would add little value to this already street-specific object.

rows.name: Road barricade

recommendation.rationale: Keep existing silhouette and gaps, use bark/earth/ochre with charcoal lashings. Do not substitute decorative city gates: this is a harvestable obstacle.

rows.name: Street lamps and dark foundation stones
rows.assessment: Very frequent road restoration marker. Procedural gold metal and soft violet glow intentionally contrast with the rustic world, but smooth supersampled metal is softer than the character pixel style.

candidate.renderer: same RoadOverlay.paintLamp, LAMP_PROFILE; simplify surface shading at source

recommendation.rationale: Keep the existing single-lantern silhouette and separate restoration light. Quantise ironwork into crisp gold/ochre clusters; preserve additive glow and existing street-specific light colours. Library LampPost_3 is a two-lantern wooden utility post, a poorer silhouette match; do not add it just to force a swap.

rows.prevalenceReason: Deterministic lamps repeat at Streets.lampSpacingM() along accepted transportation lines, including unlit foundation state before repair; high repeated screen exposure.
rows.spawnEvidence: src/streets.js lampSpacingM / lampLayFor → src/app.js _streetLampsForTile → src/render.js _streetlamp
rows.consumers: All accepted road/path lamp positions; lit flag selects restored procedural lamp or four existing foundation frames. Existing street glow colours are already-used states, not newly proposed zone variants.

excluded: Unused Generated placeholders: postbox, hay_a/b/c, shrine.png, old headstone.png, unused stake choices, review contact sheets.
notes: Input fixture counts are local source signals, not post-spawn map counts.
No new zone-specific variants nominated by structures: save the ~10% variant budget for more prevalent ground/flora where spatial identity is stronger.
Existing restored/unrestored states, product counter frames, and two grove shrine appearances are existing gameplay art, not proposed new variants.

Restored buildings retain their original brighter art. Fort and generated building treatments distinguish existing claimed/unclaimed states; these are not new zone variants. Macro POI booths stay as-is, with the chapel explicitly unchanged.
